info.title: MoySklad Universal API
info.description: MoySklad is a cloud inventory, sales, purchasing, warehouse, and document management platform. This app connects to the MoySklad JSON API 1.2 for managing catalog entities, counterparties, documents, reports, audit events, notifications, and related business records.
